senses.sense_definition: de persoon of zaak die de meeste voorkeur geniet boven anderen

examples.text: Van alle boeken in de kast is dit oude exemplaar mijn absolute <w>lieveling</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Of all the books on the shelf, this old copy is my absolute <w>favorite</w>.
target_lang_translations.it: Tra tutti i libri sullo scaffale, questa vecchia copia è la mia <w>preferita</w> in assoluto.

examples.text: Hij was dol op al zijn dochters, maar de jongste was toch wel zijn <w>lieveling</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: He adored all his daughters, but the youngest was definitely his <w>favorite</w>.
target_lang_translations.it: Adorava tutte le sue figlie, ma la più piccola era senza dubbio la sua <w>preferita</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: the person or thing that is most preferred over others
target_lang_definitions.it: La persona o cosa che si preferisce rispetto ad altre.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the person or thing preferred above all others
a person or thing that is very popular or preferred by a group

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: la persona o cosa che si predilige sopra ogni altra
persona molto amata o favorita da un gruppo o dal pubblico

senses.sense_definition: een persoon voor wie men zeer tedere en liefdevolle gevoelens koestert

examples.text: Hij kon dat zijn <w>lieveling</w> toch niet aandoen na alles wat ze samen hadden beleefd.

target_lang_translations.en: He couldn't do that to his <w>darling</w> after everything they had been through together.
target_lang_translations.it: Non poteva farlo al suo <w>tesoro</w> dopo tutto quello che avevano passato insieme.

examples.text: Kom hier, mijn kleine <w>lieveling</w>, en vertel me wat er aan de hand is.

target_lang_translations.en: Come here, my little <w>darling</w>, and tell me what is going on.
target_lang_translations.it: Vieni qui, piccolo mio <w>tesoro</w>, e dimmi cosa succede.

target_lang_definitions.en: a person for whom one has very tender and loving feelings
target_lang_definitions.it: Una persona per la quale si nutrono sentimenti molto teneri e affettuosi.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: an affectionate term for a person who is very dear

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: termine affettuoso per una persona molto cara
persona amata, usato come appellativo affettuoso

senses.sense_definition: een bepaald soort nachtvlinder uit de familie van de spanners

examples.text: Tijdens onze wandeling door het bos zagen we een zeldzame <w>lieveling</w> op een blad zitten.

target_lang_translations.en: During our walk through the forest, we saw a rare <w>darling</w> sitting on a leaf.
target_lang_translations.it: Durante la nostra passeggiata nel bosco abbiamo visto una rara <w>Timandra comae</w> posata su una foglia.

examples.text: De <w>lieveling</w> is een vlinder die vooral in een vochtige omgeving voorkomt.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>darling</w> is a moth that occurs mainly in damp environments.
target_lang_translations.it: La <w>Timandra comae</w> è una falena che si trova principalmente in ambienti umidi.

target_lang_definitions.en: a specific type of moth from the Geometridae family
target_lang_definitions.it: Un tipo specifico di falena appartenente alla famiglia dei Geometridi.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the common name for the moth species Timandra comae

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: nome scientifico della specie di falena
